1: // Simple Gravity Runner game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: // The player is a ball that falls under gravity, can move left/right
4: // and jump on moving platforms while avoiding spikes.
5: 
6: (() => {
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   if (!canvas) {
9:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
10:     return;
11:   }
12:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
13:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
14:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
15: 
16:   // Game constants
17:   const GRAVITY = 0.5;
18:   const JUMP_VEL = -10;
19:   const PLAYER_RADIUS = 15;
20:   const PLAYER_SPEED = 4;
21:   const PLATFORM_SPEED = 2;
22:   const PLATFORM_WIDTH = 100;
23:   const PLATFORM_HEIGHT = 20;
24:   const SPIKE_SIZE = 20;
25: 
26:   // Input state
27:   const keys = { left: false, right: false, up: false };
28:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
29:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = true;
30:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = true;
31:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'Space') keys.up = true;
32:   });
33:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
34:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
35:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
36:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'Space') keys.up = false;
37:   });
38: 
39:   const player = {
40:     x: W / 2,
41:     y: H - PLAYER_RADIUS - 1,
42:     vx: 0,
43:     vy: 0,
44:     onGround: false,
45:   };
46: 
47:   // Platform constructor
48:   function Platform(x, y, w = PLATFORM_WIDTH, h = PLATFORM_HEIGHT) {
49:     this.x = x;
50:     this.y = y;
51:     this.w = w;
52:     this.h = h;
53:     this.vx = -PLATFORM_SPEED; // move left
54:     this.update = function () {
55:       this.x += this.vx;
56:       // recycle when off screen
57:       if (this.x + this.w < 0) this.x = W;
58:     };
59:     this.draw = function () {
60:       ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
61:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
62:     };
63:   }
64: 
65:   // Spike constructor (simple triangle)
66:   function Spike(x, y, size = SPIKE_SIZE) {
67:     this.x = x;
68:     this.y = y;
69:     this.size = size;
70:     this.vx = -PLATFORM_SPEED;
71:     this.update = function () {
72:       this.x += this.vx;
73:       if (this.x + this.size < 0) this.x = W;
74:     };
75:     this.draw = function () {
76:       ctx.fillStyle = '#a00';
77:       ctx.beginPath();
78:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.size);
79:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.size / 2, this.y);
80:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.size, this.y + this.size);
81:       ctx.closePath();
82:       ctx.fill();
83:     };
84:   }
85: 
86:   // Generate initial platforms and spikes
87:   const platforms = [];
88:   const spikes = [];
89:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
90:     const pX = i * (W / 4) + W;
91:     const pY = H - 100 - i * 80;
92:     platforms.push(new Platform(pX, pY));
93:     // Add a spike on some platforms
94:     if (i % 2 === 0) {
95:       spikes.push(new Spike(pX + PLATFORM_WIDTH / 2, pY - SPIKE_SIZE));
96:     }
97:   }
98: 
99:   let gameOver = false;
100:   let frame = 0;
101: 
102:   function update() {
103:     if (gameOver) return;
104:     // Horizontal movement
105:     player.vx = 0;
106:     if (keys.left) player.vx = -PLAYER_SPEED;
107:     if (keys.right) player.vx = PLAYER_SPEED;
108:     // Jump
109:     if (keys.up && player.onGround) {
110:       player.vy = JUMP_VEL;
111:       player.onGround = false;
112:     }
113: 
114:     // Apply gravity
115:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
116: 
117:     // Update position
118:     player.x += player.vx;
119:     player.y += player.vy;
120: 
121:     // Keep inside horizontal bounds
122:     if (player.x - PLAYER_RADIUS < 0) player.x = PLAYER_RADIUS;
123:     if (player.x + PLAYER_RADIUS > W) player.x = W - PLAYER_RADIUS;
124: 
125:     // Collision with platforms (simple AABB check)
126:     player.onGround = false;
127:     for (const p of platforms) {
128:       // Only check when falling
129:       if (player.vy >= 0) {
130:         const withinX = player.x + PLAYER_RADIUS > p.x && player.x - PLAYER_RADIUS < p.x + p.w;
131:         const abovePlatform = player.y + PLAYER_RADIUS <= p.y && player.y + PLAYER_RADIUS + player.vy >= p.y;
132:         if (withinX && abovePlatform) {
133:           player.y = p.y - PLAYER_RADIUS;
134:           player.vy = 0;
135:           player.onGround = true;
136:         }
137:       }
138:     }
139: 
140:     // Spike collision (point inside triangle approximation using bounding box)
141:     for (const s of spikes) {
142:       const withinX = player.x > s.x && player.x < s.x + s.size;
143:       const withinY = player.y + PLAYER_RADIUS > s.y && player.y - PLAYER_RADIUS < s.y + s.size;
144:       if (withinX && withinY) {
145:         gameOver = true;
146:       }
147:     }
148: 
149:     // Fall off bottom
150:     if (player.y - PLAYER_RADIUS > H) gameOver = true;
151: 
152:     // Update platforms and spikes
153:     for (const p of platforms) p.update();
154:     for (const s of spikes) s.update();
155:   }
156: 
157:   function draw() {
158:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
159:     // Draw player
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0';
161:     ctx.beginPath();
162:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
163:     ctx.fill();
164: 
165:     // Draw platforms
166:     for (const p of platforms) p.draw();
167:     // Draw spikes
168:     for (const s of spikes) s.draw();
169: 
170:     // Game over overlay
171:     if (gameOver) {
172:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
173:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
174:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
175:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
176:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
177:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
178:     }
179:   }
180: 
181:   function loop() {
182:     if (!gameOver) {
183:       update();
184:     }
185:     draw();
186:     frame++;
187:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
188:   }
189: 
190:   // Start the game loop
191:   loop();
192: })();

(End of file - total 192 lines)
</content>
